free_text: The patient is a 61-year-old male with an elevated PSA of 11.0 ng/mL and moderate LUTS. MRI showed a focal area of restricted diffusion, but no extracapsular extension or seminal vesicle invasion was identified. The biopsy showed a benign Gleason score of 0+0 (ISUP grade group 0), though AI predicted grade group 2. Given the stable histology and imaging findings, continued surveillance is recommended, balancing the risk of progression against the potential side effects of intervention.
